verdicts.reasoning: All sampled seeds require extracting and interpreting information from the provided charts or tables, such as identifying the category with the most items (seed 11), reading specific values (seed 23), or comparing categories (seed 118).
The question texts for these seeds begin with "Look at the table", and their underlying BarChart payloads explicitly define the orientation as "table".

These seeds prompt the user with "Look at the... bar graph" and have BarChart payloads rendering visual charts with orientations strictly set to "horizontal" or "vertical", representing single bar graphs (as opposed to tables).
Seeds 11, 23, and 64 specifically mention a "horizontal bar graph" in the prompt text and their corresponding visual payloads use the "horizontal" orientation attribute.
Seeds 57, 78, 91, and 127 specifically refer to a "vertical bar graph" in the prompt and their visual payloads use the "vertical" orientation attribute.
